text_a: Esta vez envía el informe semanal en PDF.
text_b: Por esta única ocasión, manda el reporte de la semana como PDF.

text_a: From now on, put the meeting notes in the shared folder.
text_b: This time, put the meeting notes in the shared folder.
what_differs: standing rule vs one-off

text_a: Sempre que eu pedir um resumo, faça com no máximo cinco linhas.
text_b: Toda vez que eu solicitar um sumário, limite-o a cinco linhas no máximo.

text_a: Cuando revises mis correos, avísame si alguno es del banco.
text_b: Hoy cuando revises mis correos, avísame si alguno es del banco.
what_differs: 'cuando revises' may be generic or about today only; 'hoy' narrows it but the first is ambiguous

text_a: Please book the meeting room for Thursday at ten.
text_b: Please ask Dana to book the meeting room for Thursday at ten.
what_differs: do it yourself vs ask Dana to do it

text_a: Pídele a Laura que firme el contrato antes del viernes.
text_b: Dile a Laura que tiene que firmar el contrato como muy tarde el viernes.

text_a: Peça ao Marcos para revisar o código antes do deploy.
text_b: Revise o código antes do deploy.
what_differs: Marcos reviews vs the assistant reviews

text_a: Get the design team to update the logo on the website.
text_b: Have the designers change the website logo.
what_differs: 'update' vs 'change' the logo may or may not mean the same edit

text_a: Usa la cuenta personal a menos que te diga otra cosa.
text_b: Por defecto utiliza la cuenta personal; si yo indico otra, usa esa.

text_a: Always send invoices in euros, regardless of the client's country.
text_b: Send invoices in euros by default, unless the client is outside the EU.
what_differs: unconditional vs default with an exception

text_a: Salve os arquivos em formato CSV, a não ser que eu peça outro.
text_b: Salve os arquivos sempre em CSV.
what_differs: overridable default vs always

text_a: Use the staging server unless I say otherwise.
text_b: Unless I specify a different one, run it on the staging server.

text_a: Borra el archivo de registros antiguo.
text_b: Borra la carpeta de registros antiguos.
what_differs: single file vs whole folder

text_a: Archive the whole email thread with the supplier.
text_b: Archive every message in the conversation with the supplier.

text_a: Faça backup do repositório inteiro antes de mexer.
text_b: Faça backup da pasta do projeto antes de mexer.
what_differs: repository vs project folder may or may not coincide (.git history, ignored files)

text_a: Delete the row for customer 4821 from the orders table.
text_b: Delete the orders table for customer 4821.
what_differs: one row vs the whole table

text_a: Comprueba si el servidor está caído.
text_b: Reinicia el servidor si está caído.
what_differs: only check vs restart

text_a: Let me know whether the payment went through.
text_b: Tell me if the payment was processed successfully.

text_a: Verifique se o cliente já pagou a fatura.
text_b: Cobre o cliente pela fatura.
what_differs: verify payment vs actively charge

text_a: Dime qué cambiaría en el documento para que quede más claro.
text_b: Mejora el documento para que quede más claro.
what_differs: suggesting changes vs making them; could be read as the same intent

text_a: Reply to the customer in Portuguese.
text_b: Reply to the customer in Spanish.
what_differs: reply language Portuguese vs Spanish

text_a: Exporta la tabla como hoja de cálculo de Excel.
text_b: Guarda la tabla en un archivo .xlsx.

text_a: Escreva o relatório em tópicos curtos.
text_b: Escreva o relatório em parágrafos corridos.
what_differs: bullet list vs prose layout

text_a: Send me the data as a spreadsheet.
text_b: Send me the data as a CSV file.
what_differs: 'spreadsheet' may mean xlsx or may accept CSV

text_a: Manda el borrador a Pedro con copia a Ana.
text_b: Manda el borrador a Pedro con copia oculta a Ana.
what_differs: visible cc vs blind cc

text_a: Share the document only with the finance team.
text_b: Give access to the document to finance people and nobody else.

text_a: Publique o comunicado no blog da empresa.
text_b: Publique o comunicado no blog interno da empresa.
what_differs: public blog vs internal blog

text_a: Keep this between us for now.
text_b: Don't tell the rest of the team yet.
what_differs: 'between us' may exclude people beyond the team too

text_a: Ejecuta la migración en modo de prueba.
text_b: Simula la migración sin aplicar cambios reales.

text_a: Draft the reply and show it to me before sending.
text_b: Draft the reply and send it.
what_differs: needs approval first vs sends directly

text_a: Mostre-me as alterações antes de aplicar o patch.
text_b: Aplique o patch e depois me mostre as alterações.
what_differs: order: preview before applying vs apply then show

text_a: Prepara el correo de felicitación para todos los clientes.
text_b: Envía el correo de felicitación a todos los clientes.
what_differs: 'prepara' may stop at a draft or imply sending

text_a: Call Michael Torres from Apex Logistics about the delay.
text_b: Call Michael Torres from Apex Logistics Inc. about the delay.
what_differs: 'Inc.' may denote the same company or a different Apex Logistics entity

text_a: Reserva un hotel en Cartagena, Colombia.
text_b: Reserva un hotel en Cartagena, España.
what_differs: Cartagena in Colombia vs Spain

text_a: Envie o orçamento para o João Silva da contabilidade.
text_b: Envie o orçamento ao João Silva, que trabalha na contabilidade.

text_a: Update the Mercury dashboard with this quarter's numbers.
text_b: Update the Mercury dashboard with last quarter's numbers.
what_differs: this quarter vs last quarter data

text_a: Si la subida falla, vuelve a intentarlo una vez.
text_b: Si la subida falla, inténtalo otra vez, solo una.

text_a: If the build fails, stop and tell me.
text_b: If the build fails, retry once and then tell me.
what_differs: stop immediately vs retry once first

text_a: Se um arquivo não puder ser lido, pule-o e continue.
text_b: Se um arquivo não puder ser lido, pare tudo e avise.
what_differs: skip and continue vs halt and report

text_a: If the primary API is down, use the backup one.
text_b: If the main API doesn't respond, switch to the backup.
what_differs: 'down' vs 'doesn't respond' (timeouts, slow responses) may trigger fallback differently
